title: Staying on Task: Testing the Foundations of Long-Horizon Agent Reliability
abstract: arXiv:2609.38712v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon agentic workflows require models to sustain repeated state-dependent actions all while the context grows, sub-task complexity changes, and new data arrives. Each situation represents an independent axis along which an agent may fail. An agent reconciling a long ledger, for example, must repeatedly read its state, update the correct record, and preserve alignment across thousands of outputs. A model may accept the entire ledger yet lose its place or stop applying the operation consistently as generation proceeds. We introduce Long-Transduction, a controlled diagnostic that tests a model's ability to stay on task during long generation while continuously reading, mutating, and outputting input-context dependent operations such as arithmetic, sorting, variable lookups, and table transformations. translated_title: 保持任务专注：测试长时程智能体可靠性的基础
translated_abstract: 长时程智能体工作流要求模型在上下文不断增长、子任务复杂度变化以及新数据到来的同时，持续执行依赖于状态的重复操作。每一种情况都代表着一个智能体可能失败的独立维度。例如，一个对账长账本的智能体必须反复读取其状态、更新正确的记录，并在数千个输出中保持对齐。模型可能能够接收整个账本，但随着生成的进行却会迷失位置或停止一致地应用操作。我们提出了Long-Transduction，这是一个受控诊断方法，用于测试模型在长生成过程中保持任务专注的能力，其间需持续读取、修改并输出依赖于输入上下文的操作，例如算术运算、排序、变量查找和表格变换。Long-Transduction评估独立地变化局部任务复杂度、输入数据格式和上下文长度，从而隔离失败原因（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了Long-Transduction受控诊断方法，通过独立变化局部任务复杂度、输入数据格式和上下文长度三个维度，系统性地测试模型在长生成过程中持续执行状态依赖操作的能力，以定位长时程智能体可靠性失败的根本原因。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Long-Transduction, a controlled diagnostic that independently varies local task complexity, input data formatting, and context length to pinpoint where models fail to stay on task during long generation, probing the foundations of long-horizon agent reliability.
